Hi Claire — thank you, this is great.

High level: please mark any attendee who selected "Request a demo" or used language indicating deployment needs ("on-prem", "VPC", "data residency") as a demo-request MQL. Those should be routed to our SDR queue for 24-hour outreach.

Concrete ask from our side:
- Can you add a column "mql_flag" with values "demo" or "nurture" in the cleaned CSV?
- Include company domain and company size (estimated) where possible. If a registrant used a personal email, add a "personal_email" flag.
- Identify VIPs (C-level or head of platform) in a "priority_tag" column.

Ben — please confirm routing rules below so Claire can format accordingly. Marissa, marking for visibility on high-touch accounts.

Thanks,

Thanks, Sofia and Claire. Quick confirmation on SDR handling and the mapping template attached. Summary of routing rules we'll apply once we ingest the cleaned export:

- If mql_flag == "demo": create a HubSpot contact and assign to SDR queue "Workshop Demos" with outreach SLA = 24 hours.
- If priority_tag == "vip": mark contact property "high_touch" = true and include in daily review (Ben/SDR lead).
- If personal_email == true: set contact property "email_type" = "personal" and do not auto-enrich; manual research first.
- Company size > 500 (or enterprise domains): route to AE queue for direct intro.

We prefer a column "hubspot_company_id" if you already have Company matches; otherwise we will attempt domain matching. I've attached a simple mapping template (mql_mapping_template.csv) — use those column headers. We can also accept a Drive CSV at the folder listed below; we'll process nightly at 03:00 UTC if you place the cleaned file in that location.

HubSpot pipeline link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/companies/890
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1x2y3z-attendee-exports

Attachments: mql_mapping_template.csv

—Ben
